words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 社交媒体
words.ex: He uses social media to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交媒体和朋友聊天。
words.en: Websites and applications that enable users to create and share content or to participate in social networking.

words.tr: phrase. 时尚影响者；在时尚领域具有影响力并通过社交媒体等平台引导潮流的人
words.ex: Fashion influencers often collaborate with brands to promote new collections.
words.ex_cn: 时尚影响者经常与品牌合作推广新系列。
words.en: Fashion influencers are individuals who have the power to affect the purchasing decisions of others because of their authority, knowledge, position, or relationship with their audience.

words.tr: phrase. 最新的趋势；当前最流行的发展动向
words.ex: She follows the latest trends on social media.
words.ex_cn: 她关注社交媒体上的最新趋势。
words.en: The most recent and popular developments or changes in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 评论区；评论部分（通常指文章、视频或社交媒体下方供用户发表意见的区域）
words.ex: He wrote a comment in the comments section.
words.ex_cn: 他在评论区写了一条评论。
words.en: The area beneath an online article or video where readers can post their opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 为趋势名称添加标签；标记趋势名称
words.ex: He tags the trend name on social media.
words.ex_cn: 他在社交媒体上标记趋势名称。
words.en: To label a social media post with a popular topic or hashtag to increase visibility.

words.tr: phrase. 官方商店；旗舰店
words.ex: I bought a T-shirt from the official store.
words.ex_cn: 我从官方商店买了一件T恤。
words.en: A retail outlet authorized by a brand to sell its products directly to consumers.

words.tr: adj. 价格过高的； v. “overprice”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The coffee at that café is overpriced.
words.ex_cn: 那家咖啡馆的咖啡价格过高。
words.en: If you say that something is overpriced, you mean that you think it costs much more than it should.

words.tr: phrase. 高品牌溢价；指某一品牌因其知名度、声誉或 perceived quality 而能够以远高于同类产品价格销售所带来的额外价值
words.ex: The phone has a high brand premium because people trust its name.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机因为人们信任它的品牌而价格很高。
words.en: A significant price increase associated with a luxury or prestigious brand name.

words.tr: phrase. 不划算的；成本效益不佳的；不经济的
words.ex: This machine is not cost-effective for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器对小企业来说不划算。
words.en: Not providing good value for the money spent; inefficient in terms of cost.

words.tr: phrase. 不值这个价的；价格不划算的
words.ex: The phone is not worth the price.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机不值这个价钱。
words.en: Not meriting the amount of money asked for; deemed too expensive for what is offered.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找一个仿品／替代品（尤指化妆品或时尚单品）
words.ex: He is searching for a dupe in the old files.
words.ex_cn: 他正在旧文件中寻找一个复制品。
words.en: To look for a cheaper alternative product that closely resembles a more expensive one.

words.tr: phrase. 完全相同的设计；一致的设计方案
words.ex: The two shoes have identical design.
words.ex_cn: 这两双鞋的设计完全相同。
words.en: Looking exactly the same as another item in design and appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 外观相似的；看起来相像的
words.ex: The two coins are similar looking.
words.ex_cn: 这两枚硬币看起来很相似。
words.en: Having a similar appearance or design to something else, but not identical.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 能负担得起的价格；合理的价位
words.ex: The store offers an affordable price for fresh vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店为新鲜蔬菜提供实惠的价格。
words.en: A price that is within the financial means of most people.

words.tr: n.复审
words.ex: The committee gave the proposal several reviews.
words.ex_cn: 委员会对这个提案进行了多次复审。
words.en: A review is a report in which someone gives their opinion of something such as a new book or film. If you review a situation or system, you consider it carefully to see what is wrong with it or how it could be improved.

words.tr: phrase. 真实照片；实拍照片；非合成或虚构的照片
words.ex: He showed me real photos of his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行的真实照片。
words.en: Genuine images of a product, not computer-generated or stock photos.

words.tr: phrase. 客户服务；顾客服务
words.ex: The customer service helped me fix my order.
words.ex_cn: 客服帮助我解决了我的订单问题。
words.en: The assistance and advice provided by a company to those people who buy or use its products or services.

words.tr: phrase. 现在可用的；立即可得的
words.ex: The tickets are available now.
words.ex_cn: 票现在可以买了。
words.en: Immediately obtainable or accessible for purchase or use.

words.tr: phrase. 有库存；有现货
words.ex: The apples are in stock.
words.ex_cn: 苹果有货。
words.en: Available for sale or use; in the store or warehouse.

words.tr: phrase. 准备发货的；随时可出货的
words.ex: The boxes are ready to ship.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子准备好发货了。
words.en: An item that is in stock and can be dispatched to the customer without delay.

words.tr: v. 预订；预定；n. 预购；预订单
words.ex: He will pre-order the new game online.
words.ex_cn: 他将在网上预购这款新游戏。
words.en: To reserve and pay for an item that is not yet available for immediate purchase or delivery.

words.tr: phrase. 预计送达时间；预估交货时间
words.ex: The estimated delivery time is three days.
words.ex_cn: 预计的送达时间是三天。
words.en: The projected date or time period by which a purchased item is expected to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 当日送达；同日递送服务
words.ex: The store offers same-day delivery for online orders.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店为在线订单提供当日送达服务。
words.en: A delivery service that delivers an item on the same day the order is placed.

words.tr: phrase. 次日送达；次日投递服务
words.ex: The company offers next-day delivery for all orders placed before 5 PM.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司为所有在下午5点前下的订单提供次日送达服务。
words.en: Next-day delivery refers to a service where goods or packages are delivered the day after they are dispatched.

words.tr: phrase. 标准配送；普通快递服务
words.ex: The package will arrive by standard delivery next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹将在下周通过普通快递送达。
words.en: A regular, non-expedited delivery service with a standard timeframe.

words.tr: phrase. 标准运输；普通邮寄方式
words.ex: The package will arrive by standard shipping in five days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹将通过标准快递在五天内到达。
words.en: The standard method of sending goods, typically slower than express options.

words.tr: phrase. 下订单；下单；发出订购请求
words.ex: Please place your order at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 请在柜台下单。
words.en: To submit a request to purchase a product or service.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.tr: phrase. 试穿；试验
words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: 短语. 合适的人选或事物；很匹配
words.ex: This job is a good fit for her.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作很适合她。
words.en: Suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 非常显瘦的；极有助瘦身视觉效果的
words.ex: This dress is very slimming.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子非常显瘦。
words.en: Having the effect of making someone appear thinner.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.tr: phrase. 保持原样；保持住；别弄坏它；继续这样做
words.ex: I will keep it simple.
words.ex_cn: 我会保持它简单。
words.en: An imperative phrase meaning to maintain or preserve something in its current state.

words.tr: adj. 纸一样的，薄而干的
words.ex: The leaves turned papery as the autumn winds blew.
words.ex_cn: 秋风吹过，叶子变得像纸一样薄。
words.en: Resembling paper in thinness or texture; thin and light like paper.

words.tr: adj. 便宜的；廉价的；
words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr: phrase. 使你看起来更大；让你显得更魁梧
words.ex: Padded shoulders makes you look bigger.
words.ex_cn: 垫肩让你看起来更魁梧。
words.en: Causes someone to seem larger in size than they are.

words.tr: phrase. 太松了；过于宽松
words.ex: The rope is too loose to hold the box.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子太松了，无法固定箱子。
words.en: Not fitting closely or tightly; too large for the wearer.

words.tr: phrase. 太轻的；不够重的
words.ex: The box is too light to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子太轻了，搬不动。
words.en: Not heavy enough; lacking sufficient weight or substance.

words.tr: phrase. 申请退回；申请退款
words.ex: He wants to apply for return of his money.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请退回他的钱。
words.en: Request to send back a purchased item for a refund or exchange.

words.tr: phrase. 返回码；回传代码（程序执行后返回给调用者以指示执行结果的数值）
words.ex: The program shows a return code of 1.
words.ex_cn: 程序显示返回代码为1。
words.en: A unique identifier used to track and process a return shipment.

words.tr: n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr: phrase. 快递服务；特快专递
words.ex: He sent the package by express courier.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快递公司寄出了包裹。
words.en: A fast, premium shipping service for urgent deliveries.

words.tr: phrase. 递送员；快递员；负责运送货物或包裹的人员
words.ex: The delivery courier brought the package to my door.
words.ex_cn: 快递员把包裹送到了我的门口。
words.en: A service responsible for transporting goods to the recipient.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.
